verdict.rationale: Automations can be saved as YAML workflow contracts and stored as validated Workflow records in the Git-native Ledger. That gives them Git-based versioning, and Skills are independently versioned with guidance to review the canonical version before installing. However, there is no documented review flow for workflow changes and no explicit rollback or revert capability for automations. Missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of workflow definitions, an explicit review/diff process for automation changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
